title: 在獄詠蟬
author: 駱賓王
title_en: On the Cicada, Written in Prison
english: In autumn's western quarter the cicada sings
A captive's homesick thoughts steal over me
How can I bear its dark-winged shadow
Coming to chant before my whitened head
The dew is heavy, flight is hard to gain
The wind is strong, its cry is easily drowned
No one believes in lofty purity
Who then will speak the heart within me
gist: A prisoner's pure heart, like the cicada's, unheard

title: 經鄒魯祭孔子而歎之
author: 明皇帝
title_en: Passing Zou and Lu, I Sacrifice to Confucius and Sigh
english: Master, what was it that you strove for
Restless and hurried through your single age
The land is still the town of the Zou clan
Your house became the King of Lu's own palace
You sighed for the phoenix, mourning your ill fate
Grieved for the unicorn, lamenting the Way's end
Now I see offerings set between the pillars
Just as it was within your dream of old
gist: Confucius strove restless, honored only after death

title: 新嫁娘詞其三
author: 王建
title_en: Song of the New Bride, III
english: On the third day she goes into the kitchen
Washes her hands and makes the broth
Not yet knowing her mother-in-law's taste
She has her husband's young sister try it first
gist: New bride tests her broth on the young sister first

title: 故行宮
author: 王建
english: Desolate lies the old imperial lodge
Palace flowers redden in loneliness
White-haired palace women still remain
Sitting idle, they talk of Xuanzong
gist: In a deserted palace, old women recall Xuanzong

title: 蟬
author: 李商隱
english: Perched high by nature, it can hardly eat its fill
In vain its bitter cries are spent
By the fifth watch its sparse notes near breaking
Yet one whole tree stays green, unmoved
A petty official, I drift like a loosed twig
The weeds of my old garden have grown level
I thank you, friend, for this most timely warning
My household too is poor and pure
gist: The cicada cries unheard, poor and pure as the poet

title: 樂遊原
author: 李商隱
english: Toward evening my heart was ill at ease
I drove my carriage up the ancient plain
The setting sun is boundlessly lovely
Only, the dusk is drawing near
gist: The sunset is boundlessly lovely, but dusk is near

title: 風雨
author: 李商隱
english: Desolate, my song of the precious sword
Adrift and lodging on toward my years' end
Yellow leaves still in the wind and rain
Blue mansions keep to their pipes and strings
New friends run afoul of a shallow world
Old companions cut off from kindly fate
My heart despairs of Xinfeng wine
How many thousands a jar to drown this sorrow
gist: Adrift in wind and rain, he drowns sorrow in wine

title: 落花
author: 李商隱
english: From the high pavilion the guest at last has gone
In the small garden petals whirl and fly
Scattered, they trail along the winding paths
Stretching far, they see the slanting light away
Heartbroken, I cannot bear to sweep them
I strain my eyes, still longing for their return
Their fragrant hearts are spent along with spring
All that is gained is a robe wet with tears
gist: He cannot sweep the petals that die with spring

title: 涼思
author: 李商隱
title_en: Thoughts in the Cool of Autumn
english: The guest has gone; waves lie level with the rail
Cicadas hush; dew fills the branches
Long are my musings in this season
Leaning where I stand, time slips away unmarked
The Northern Dipper, like the spring, is far
The messenger from Nanling comes too slowly
At the sky's edge I read my dreams again and again
Fearing, perhaps wrongly, you have found new friends
gist: In autumn he waits, fearing a friend found new ties

title: 北青蘿
author: 李商隱
english: The fading sun sinks west behind the hills
I seek a lone monk at his thatched hut
Among the falling leaves, where can he be?
How many turns of road through the cold clouds?
Alone he strikes the chime as night begins
then leans at ease upon a rattan staff
The whole world rests within a mote of dust
why should I hold to love and hate?
gist: Seeking a monk, he sees the world as a mote of dust

title: 章臺夜思
author: 韋莊
english: A clear zither laments the endless night
wind and rain grieve about its strings
By a lone lamp I hear the horn of Chu
the waning moon goes down past Zhangtai
The fragrant grasses have come to their end
and still my old friend does not arrive
Letters for home can find no way
the autumn geese turn south once more
gist: Night zither grieves, letters home can find no way

title: 楚江懷古其一
author: 馬戴
title_en: Thoughts of the Past on the Chu River, I
english: Dew-laden air gathers its cold light
the faint sun sinks behind the hills of Chu
Gibbons cry in the trees of Dongting
a traveler drifts in a magnolia boat
Over the broad marsh a bright moon rises
gray mountains hem the tumbling streams
The Lord Within the Clouds does not descend
all night alone I grieve for autumn
gist: A boat on Chu waters, grieving autumn all night

title: 灞上秋居
author: 馬戴
english: On the Ba plain the wind and rain have stilled
at dusk I watch flight after flight of geese
Leaves fall from trees of a land not mine
by a cold lamp, one man alone at night
In the empty garden white dew drips
past a lone wall, a hermit monk for neighbor
Long have I lodged beside this rustic gate
at whose door shall I offer up my service?
gist: Alone in autumn exile, he wonders whom to serve

title: 沒蕃故人
author: 張籍
title_en: For a Friend Lost in Tibet
english: Two years ago we marched against the Yuezhi
beneath the walls the whole army was lost
Between Tibet and Han all news is severed
dead or alive, we are parted for good
No one gathers up the abandoned tents
returning horses know the tattered flags
I would mourn you, yet you may still live
so at the sky's edge I weep this hour
gist: Mourning a friend lost in war who may yet live

title: 春怨
author: 金昌緒
english: Drive off the yellow orioles
do not let them cry upon the branch
Their crying startles me from dreams
and I can never reach Liaoxi
gist: She drives off orioles that break her dream of him

title: 行宮
author: 元稹
english: Desolate, the ancient traveling palace
its flowers blush red in loneliness
White-haired palace women still remain
sitting idle, talking of Xuanzong
gist: Faded palace flowers, white haired women reminisce

title: 哥舒歌
author: 西鄙人
english: The seven stars of the Dipper hang high
Geshu carries his blade by night
To this day those who eye our grazing horses
dare not venture past Lintao
gist: With Geshu on guard, raiders dare not pass Lintao

title: 雜詩其三
author: 沈佺期
english: They say that at the Yellow Dragon post
year after year the fighting does not cease
Pity the moon above her lonely chamber
forever shining on the Han camps too
The young wife's longing this spring
her husband's tenderness last night
Who can take up the banners and the drums
and seize Dragon City at a single stroke?
gist: One moon shines on her chamber and his far camp

title: 次北固山下
author: 王灣
english: The traveler's road runs beyond the green hills
My boat moves on before the emerald water
The tide is full, the two banks stretch wide
With a fair wind a single sail hangs taut
The sea's sun is born from the fading night
Spring on the river enters the old year
Where can my letter home be delivered?
By the returning geese, to Luoyang
gist: Full tide, fair wind, geese carry his letter home

title: 輞川閑居贈裴秀才迪
author: 王維
title_en: Dwelling at Ease in Wangchuan, for Scholar Pei Di
english: The cold hills turn a deeper blue-green
Autumn waters murmur on day after day
Leaning on my staff outside the wicker gate
I face the wind, hearing evening cicadas
At the ferry the setting sun lingers
From the village rises a lone thread of smoke
Again I meet you, drunk like Jieyu of old
Singing wildly before the Five Willows
gist: Evening in the hills, a drunken friend sings wildly

title: 酬張少府
author: 王維
english: In my late years I care only for quiet
The world's ten thousand affairs no longer concern me
I look at myself: I have no grand designs
I only know to return to my old woods
Pine winds blow as I loosen my sash
The mountain moon shines on my playing qin
You ask the law of failure and success
A fisherman's song fades deep into the cove
gist: Old age asks only quiet, a fisher's song for answer

title: 送梓州李使君
author: 王維
title_en: Seeing Off Governor Li to Zizhou
english: In ten thousand ravines the trees touch the sky
Through a thousand hills the cuckoos are calling
After one night of rain in the mountains
A hundred springs cascade from the treetops
Han women bring tribute of tong-flower cloth
Ba men bring lawsuits over taro fields
Wen Weng transformed that land by teaching
Do not simply rest on the sages of old
gist: A land of ravines and springs awaits his good rule

title: 春宮怨
author: 杜荀鶴
english: Early on, my beauty proved my undoing
Meaning to adorn myself, I face the mirror, listless
Since imperial favor does not rest on looks
How then should I compose my face?
In the warm wind, birdsong scatters in fragments
As the sun climbs, flower shadows lie layered
Year after year, the girls of the Yue stream
I remember them, gathering lotus blossoms
gist: Beauty won her nothing, she longs for lotus streams

title: 旅宿
author: 杜牧
english: At the inn there is no good companion
Lost in feeling, I grow quietly sorrowful
By a cold lamp I brood on things long past
A stray goose startles my troubled sleep
Dreams of home return only toward daybreak
Letters from home arrive a year apart
On the Xiang the mist and moon are lovely
A fishing boat lies tied before the gate
gist: Alone at an inn, dreams of home come only at dawn

title: 早秋其一
author: 許渾
english: Through the long night drifts a clear zither's sound
The west wind stirs among the green vines
The last fireflies settle on jade-white dew
Early geese brush past the River of Stars
Tall trees at daybreak are still thick with leaves
Far mountains in clear air seem more numerous
In Huainan a single leaf comes down
And I feel myself grow old on misty waves
gist: One falling leaf, and he feels old on misty waves

title: 秋日赴闕題潼關驛樓
author: 許渾
title_en: Autumn Day, Bound for Court: Inscribed on the Tongguan Post Tower
english: Red leaves rustle down in the evening
At the wayside pavilion, one gourd of wine
Torn clouds drift home to Mount Taihua
A thin rain passes over Zhongtiao
The trees' colors follow the hills into the distance
The river's voice runs far toward the sea
Tomorrow I arrive at the imperial city
Yet still I dream of fishermen and woodcutters
gist: Near the court, he dreams of fishermen and woodsmen

title: 喜見外弟又言別
author: 李益
title_en: Joy at Meeting My Cousin, Only to Speak of Parting
english: After ten years of separation and war
Grown to adulthood, we meet but once
I ask your surname, startled as at first sight
You speak your name, and I recall your old face
Since we parted, seas have turned to fields
Our talk ends with the bell of evening
Tomorrow you take the road to Baling
Autumn mountains, how many folds between us again
gist: After ten years cousins meet, only to part again

title: 江南詞
author: 李益
english: I married a merchant of Qutang Gorge
Morning after morning he breaks his word to me
Had I known the tide keeps such good faith
I would have wed a rider of the tides
gist: Better to wed the faithful tide than a merchant

title: 聽箏
author: 李端
english: The zheng rings out on its golden-grain pegs
Pale hands play before the jade chamber
Hoping to win a glance from Master Zhou
Now and then she brushes a string awry
gist: She strikes wrong notes to win her lover's glance

title: 賊平後送人北歸
author: 司空曙
title_en: Seeing Off a Friend Going North After the Rebels Were Crushed
english: In troubled times we fled south together
Now peace has come, you go north alone
In a strange land white hairs have grown
In the old homeland you will see green hills again
Under the dawn moon you pass ruined ramparts
Beneath crowded stars you lodge at the old pass
Cold birds and withered grasses
Everywhere will keep your sad face company
gist: Peace comes, a friend goes north alone past ruins

title: 雲陽館與韓紳宿別
author: 司空曙
title_en: Parting from Han Shen After a Night at the Yunyang Inn
english: Old friend, we parted by river and sea
How often mountains and streams lay between us
Meeting so suddenly, I take it for a dream
In shared sorrow we ask each other's age
A lone lamp coldly lights the rain
Wet bamboo darkens under drifting mist
Tomorrow morning brings its own regret
So we cherish the parting cup we pass
gist: Reunion feels like a dream before parting again

title: 喜外弟盧綸見宿
author: 司空曙
title_en: Joy That My Cousin Lu Lun Stays the Night
english: Still night, no neighbors on any side
A rundown home, the family fortune gone
In the rain, a tree of yellow leaves
Under the lamp, a white-haired man
Because I have sunk in solitude so long
I am ashamed you come to see me so often
All our lives fate has bound us together
The more so as kin, like the house of Cai
gist: Yellow leaves, white hair, yet kin still comes

title: 聽彈琴
author: 劉長卿
english: Clear notes ripple from the seven strings
In stillness I hear cold wind in the pines
Though I love the ancient airs myself
Few people play them anymore
gist: He loves the ancient airs few care to play now

title: 送方外上人
author: 劉長卿
title_en: Seeing Off a Monk Who Lives Beyond the World
english: A lone cloud escorting a wild crane
How could you dwell in the world of men
Do not buy land on Wozhou Mountain
People already know that place too well
gist: True hermits shun even famous mountain retreats

title: 送靈澈上人
author: 劉長卿
english: Deep green, the Bamboo Grove Temple
Faint and far, the evening bell
His straw hat carries the setting sun
Alone he returns deep into the green hills
gist: Bearing the sunset, a monk walks into green hills

title: 新年作
author: 劉長卿
english: Longing for home sharpens with the new year
At the sky's edge I weep alone
Old age has come, yet I serve beneath others
Spring goes home before this wanderer can
Mountain gibbons share my dawns and dusks
River willows share the wind and mist
Already I am like the tutor of Changsha
From now on, how many years more
gist: New Year deepens an aging exile's homesickness

title: 尋南溪常山道人隱居
author: 劉長卿
title_en: Seeking the Recluse Daoist Changshan by the South Stream
english: All along the path where I walked,
footprints show in the moss.
White clouds rest on the quiet islet;
spring grass closes the idle gate.
After rain I gaze at the color of pines,
following the hills to the water's source.
Stream flowers and the mind of Chan:
face to face, we forget all words.
gist: Seeking a hermit, they meet and words fall away

title: 餞別王十一南遊
author: 劉長卿
title_en: A Farewell Feast for Wang the Eleventh, Journeying South
english: I watch you cross the wide misty waters,
waving as tears soak my kerchief.
Where has the flying bird vanished?
The green hills face me, empty now.
One sail fades far down the Yangtze;
sunset brings spring to the Five Lakes.
Who will see me on the sandbar,
grieving with longing among white duckweed?
gist: A sail fades south, leaving grief on the shore

title: 望洞庭湖贈張丞相
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Gazing at Lake Dongting: For Prime Minister Zhang
english: In the eighth month the lake lies level,
holding the void, merged with the sky.
Vapors steam over the Yunmeng marshes;
waves shake the walls of Yueyang.
I would cross, but have no boat or oar;
idle in a sage's reign, I feel ashamed.
Sitting here, I watch the anglers,
left only with vain envy of their fish.
gist: Facing the vast lake, he longs for a patron's boat

title: 秦中感秋寄遠上人
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Autumn Feelings in Qin, Sent to the Reverend Yuan
english: I have long wished to rest on a single hill,
yet lack the means for a recluse's paths.
This northern land was never my desire;
I think of my master at Donglin.
My gold is spent like cassia burned for fuel;
my bold ambitions fade with the years.
At dusk the cold wind arrives;
hearing cicadas only deepens my sorrow.
gist: Broke in the north, he yearns for a hermit's hill

title: 宿桐廬江寄廣陵舊遊
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Lodging on the Tonglu River, Sent to Old Friends in Guangling
english: Hills darken, and I hear the apes' sad cries;
the cold river rushes through the night.
Wind rattles the leaves on both banks;
moonlight falls on one lonely boat.
Jiande is not my native soil;
I recall old friends in Yangzhou.
So I send these two streams of tears
far away to the sea's western shore.
gist: From a lone night boat he sends tears to friends

title: 早寒江上有懷
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Thoughts on the River in Early Cold
english: Leaves fall as geese cross southward;
the north wind chills the river.
My home lies by the waters of Xiang,
far beyond the clouds of Chu.
A wanderer, my homesick tears are spent;
I watch a lone sail at the sky's edge.
Lost at the ford, I would ask the way;
the sea-flat waters stretch on in the dusk.
gist: Homesick as geese go south, he is lost at the ford

title: 留別王侍御維
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Taking Leave of Wang Wei, Attendant Censor
english: In silence, what am I still waiting for?
Morning after morning I return with nothing.
I would go seek the fragrant grasses,
yet grieve to part from my old friend.
Who among the powerful would help me?
True friends are rare in this world.
I should only keep to my solitude
and close my old garden gate again.
gist: Unwanted at court, he leaves a rare friend behind

title: 清明日宴梅道士房
author: 孟浩然
title_en: A Feast at Daoist Mei's Chamber on Qingming Day
english: Lying in the woods, I grieved that spring was ending;
I opened the window to view the season's splendor.
Suddenly came a bluebird messenger,
inviting me to the home of Master Red Pine.
The alchemist's stove has just been lit;
immortal peach trees are shedding their blossoms.
If youthful looks could be made to stay,
why grudge getting drunk on flowing rose-cloud wine?
gist: Since youth won't stay, drink the immortal's wine

title: 與諸子登峴山
author: 孟浩然
english: Human affairs rise and pass away;
their comings and goings make past and present.
Rivers and hills keep their famous sites,
and we in our turn climb to look out.
Waters sink low, the fish weir shows shallow;
the sky is cold, Dream Marsh lies deep.
The words on Lord Yang's stone still stand;
reading them through, tears wet my lapel.
gist: Ages pass, yet an old stone still moves men to tears

title: 過故人莊
author: 孟浩然
english: My old friend has prepared chicken and millet
And invites me out to his farmhouse
Green trees close in around the village
Blue hills slant away beyond the walls
We open the feast facing yard and garden
Cups in hand, we talk of mulberry and hemp
Wait until the Double Ninth festival
I will come again for the chrysanthemums
gist: A farm feast so warm he vows to return in autumn

title: 歲暮歸南山
author: 孟浩然
title_en: Returning to South Mountain at Year's End
english: No more petitions at the northern palace gates
I return to my humble hut on South Mountain
Lacking talent, cast aside by a wise ruler
Often ill, my old friends drift away
White hairs hurry old age onward
Spring's green light presses out the year
Endless sorrow keeps me from sleep
Pine and moon, the night window empty
gist: Rejected and aging, sleepless under pine and moon

title: 歲除夜有懷
author: 孟浩然
english: Far and winding, the roads of the Three Ba
In peril, a traveler ten thousand miles from home
A night of tangled hills and lingering snow
By a lone lamp, a stranger in a foreign land
Slowly I drift further from my own kin
And grow closer instead to my servants
How can I bear this endless wandering
Tomorrow the year turns new again
gist: New Year turns while he wanders far from all kin

title: 春曉
author: 孟浩然
english: Sleeping in spring, I miss the dawn
Everywhere I hear the calling birds
Night brought the sound of wind and rain
Who knows how many blossoms fell
gist: Waking to birdsong, he wonders how many petals fell

title: 宿建德江
author: 孟浩然
english: I move my boat to moor by a misty islet
At sunset a traveler's sorrow rises anew
The wilds are vast, the sky hangs low on the trees
The river is clear, the moon draws near to me
gist: Moored at dusk, only the river moon comes close

title: 客夜與故人偶集
author: 戴叔倫
title_en: A Night Away, Meeting an Old Friend by Chance
english: Autumn sky, and the moon is full again
The city towers deep in the layered night
Once more we gather south of the river
Yet I suspect we are meeting in a dream
Wind in the branches startles hidden magpies
Dew-soaked grass covers the cold crickets
Long on the road, we may as well stay drunk
We hold each other back, dreading the dawn bell
gist: Old friends drink late, dreading the dawn bell

title: 和張僕射塞下曲其一
author: 盧綸
title_en: Border Songs for Minister Zhang, No. 1
english: Vulture feathers fletch his golden arrows
Swallow-tailed, his embroidered banner flies
Standing alone, he proclaims the new command
A thousand camps answer with a single shout
gist: One command, and a thousand camps roar as one

title: 和張僕射塞下曲其二
author: 盧綸
title_en: Border Songs for Minister Zhang, No. 2
english: In dark woods, the grass starts in the wind
The general draws his bow in the night
At dawn they search for the white-feathered shaft
Buried deep in a ridge of stone
gist: His night arrow found at dawn, sunk deep in stone

title: 和張僕射塞下曲其三
author: 盧綸
title_en: Border Songs for Minister Zhang, No. 3
english: The moon is dark, wild geese fly high
The Khan flees under cover of night
We would chase him with light cavalry
Heavy snow covers our bows and swords
gist: The foe flees by night, snow blankets the pursuit

title: 和張僕射塞下曲其四
author: 盧綸
title_en: Border Songs, Fourth of the Series, Matching Zhang the Puye
english: In the wild camp a splendid feast is spread
Qiang and Rong tribes hail the triumphant return
Drunk, the men dance in golden armor
Thundering drums shake mountains and rivers
gist: Victory feast, drunk dancers, drums shake the hills

title: 李端公
author: 盧綸
english: Withered grass covers the old frontier pass
Parting is sorrow enough in itself
Your road leads out beyond the cold clouds
I turn back as the evening snow comes down
Orphaned young, I early wandered as a stranger
Through many troubles, I came to know you late
Hiding my tears, I gaze after you in vain
In this windblown dust, where shall we meet again?
gist: Snowbound farewell, when in the dust shall we meet

title: 過香積寺
author: 王維
english: Not knowing where Xiangji Temple lay
I walked for miles into cloud-wrapped peaks
Ancient trees, a path without a soul
Deep in the hills, a bell from somewhere
The spring's voice sobs against steep rocks
Sunlight lies cold on the green pines
At dusk, by the bend of an empty pool
Calm meditation tames the poison dragon
gist: A far bell in cloud wrapped hills stills the heart

title: 山居秋暝
author: 王維
english: Empty hills after the fresh rain
The evening air has turned to autumn
The bright moon shines between the pines
A clear spring flows over the stones
Bamboo rustles: washing girls head home
Lotus leaves stir: a fishing boat glides down
Let the fragrance of spring fade as it will
A noble wanderer may well linger here
gist: After rain, moonlit pines invite one to linger

title: 終南別業
author: 王維
english: In middle age I grew to love the Way
Late in life I settled by South Mountain's edge
When the mood takes me, I go out alone
Its wonders are known to me alone
I walk to where the stream runs out
Then sit and watch the clouds rise
By chance I meet an old man of the woods
We talk and laugh with no thought of return
gist: Walking to the stream's end, he watches clouds rise

title: 歸嵩山作
author: 王維
title_en: Written on Returning to Mount Song
english: The clear river skirts long belts of brush
My horse and carriage move on at ease
The flowing water seems to share my mind
The evening birds return home with me
A ruined town overlooks the ancient ferry
The setting sun fills the autumn hills
Far away, at the foot of lofty Song
I come home and shut my gate at last
gist: Homeward with river and birds, he shuts his gate

title: 終南山
author: 王維
english: Taiyi rises near the capital of heaven
Its ranges reach to the corner of the sea
White clouds close behind me as I look back
Blue haze fades to nothing as I draw near
At the central peak the star-fields change
Shade and sunlight differ in every valley
Seeking a place to lodge for the night
I call across the stream to a woodcutter
gist: Vast peaks in shifting cloud, he hails a woodcutter

title: 漢江臨汎
author: 王維
english: The Chu frontier joins the Three Xiang streams
Through Jingmen the nine branches flow as one
The river runs beyond heaven and earth
Mountain hues hover between seen and unseen
Towns seem to float upon the shore ahead
Rolling waves set the distant sky in motion
Xiangyang has such fine days of wind and sun
I will stay and drink with the old man of the hills
gist: A river past heaven and earth, towns seem to float

title: 鹿柴
author: 王維
english: On the empty mountain, no one in sight
Yet echoes of voices can be heard
Returning light enters the deep forest
And shines once more upon the green moss
gist: Unseen voices, late light falls on the green moss

title: 竹里館
author: 王維
english: Sitting alone in the secluded bamboo grove,
I play my zither and whistle long again.
Deep in the woods, no one knows I am here;
The bright moon comes to shine upon me.
gist: Alone with a zither, only the bright moon visits

title: 送別
author: 王維
english: In the hills our parting is over;
At dusk I close my wooden gate.
Next year the spring grass will be green again;
Will you, my friend, return or not?
gist: Grass will green again, but will my friend return

title: 雜詩其二
author: 王維
title_en: Miscellaneous Poem, Second of the Series
english: You have come from our old hometown,
So you must know the news from home.
The day you left, before the patterned window,
Had the winter plum put out its blossoms yet?
gist: He asks a hometown guest if the plum has bloomed

title: 相思
author: 王維
english: Red beans grow in the southern land;
When autumn comes they sprout on old branches.
I hope you will gather many of them,
For they best embody love's yearning.
gist: Gather red beans, they carry love's deep yearning

title: 長干曲其一
author: 崔顥
title_en: Song of Changgan, First of the Series
english: Sir, where is it that you live?
I myself live at Hengtang.
I halt my boat to ask a moment;
Perhaps we come from the same town.
gist: She halts her boat, perhaps they share a hometown

title: 長干曲其二
author: 崔顥
title_en: Song of Changgan, Second of the Series
english: My home stands by the Nine Rivers' waters;
I come and go along the Nine Rivers' banks.
We are both people of Changgan,
Yet from childhood we never met.
gist: Neighbors on the same river who never met before

title: 終南望餘雪
author: 祖詠
title_en: Gazing at Lingering Snow on Zhongnan
english: Fair is the north slope of Zhongnan Mountain,
Its piled snow floating above the clouds.
The treetops shine with the clearing sky's light,
While evening cold deepens within the city.
gist: Snow gleams on the peak, cold deepens in the town

title: 塞下曲其一
author: 王昌齡
title_en: Frontier Song, First of the Series
english: Cicadas cry in the bare mulberry woods;
In the eighth month, on the Xiaoguan road,
Cold, we pass out through the frontier and back;
Everywhere the yellow reeds and grasses.
Since ancient times the men of You and Bing
Have all grown old amid the dust and sand.
Do not imitate the wandering knights
Who boast about their fine purple steeds.
gist: Border men age in sand, spurn the boastful knights

title: 塞下曲其二
author: 王昌齡
title_en: Frontier Song, Second of the Series
english: We water our horses crossing autumn streams;
The water is cold, the wind cuts like a knife.
Over level sands the sun has not yet set;
Dim in the distance we make out Lintao.
In bygone days, battles at the Great Wall,
All said, were fought with lofty spirit.
Yellow dust fills past and present alike,
And white bones lie tangled in the weeds.
gist: Old wars leave white bones in the yellow dust

title: 宿王昌齡隱居
author: 常建
english: The clear stream runs deep beyond all measure
At his hidden home, only a lone cloud
A faint moon shows between the pines
Its clear light still shines for you
Flower shadows rest by the thatched pavilion
Moss patterns spread through the herb garden
I too will take my leave of the world
To join the phoenixes and cranes of West Mountain
gist: A moonlit hermitage stirs his own vow to retreat

title: 賦得古原草送別
author: 白居易
title_en: Grass on the Ancient Plain: A Farewell
english: Thick and lush, the grass upon the plain
Each year it withers, each year it thrives
Wildfire cannot burn it all away
When spring winds blow, it grows again
Its far fragrance overruns the ancient road
Its sunlit green reaches the ruined town
Once more I send a noble friend away
The teeming grass is full of parting grief
gist: Grass that outlives fire fills parting with grief

title: 問劉十九
author: 白居易
title_en: A Question for Liu the Nineteenth
english: Green foam floats on freshly brewed wine
A little stove glows, made of red clay
Evening comes, and snow is on the way
Can you drink a cup with me or not?
gist: New wine, a warm stove, snow coming, come and drink

title: 尋隱者不遇
author: 賈島
title_en: Seeking the Hermit and Not Finding Him
english: Beneath the pines I ask his young pupil
He says the master has gone to gather herbs
He is somewhere on this very mountain
But the clouds are deep, and none knows where
gist: The hermit gathers herbs, lost in the deep clouds

title: 送人東遊
author: 溫庭筠
title_en: Seeing Off a Friend Traveling East
english: Yellow leaves fall on the deserted fort
Resolute, you leave the old frontier pass
High winds sweep the Hanyang ferry crossing
First sunlight strikes Yingmen Mountain
How many friends remain along the river?
A lone boat returns from the world's far edge
When shall we ever meet again
And ease our parting faces with a cup of wine?
gist: Leaves fall as he departs, when will we drink again

title: 渡漢江
author: 李頻
english: Beyond the ranges, letters from home ceased
A year went by, and spring came round again
Nearing home, my heart grows more afraid
I dare not question travelers coming toward me
gist: Nearing home at last, he fears to ask for news

title: 春宮怨
author: 周朴
english: From the first, my beauty was my undoing
Before the mirror, too listless to adorn myself
Winning favor does not depend on looks
So how am I to paint my face at all?
In the warm wind, birdsong breaks and scatters
Under the high sun, flower shadows deepen
Year after year, the girls of the Yue stream
Remember when we gathered lotus together
gist: Her beauty wins no favor, she mourns lost freedom

title: 孤鴈其二
author: 崔塗
english: Line after line has flown home and gone
A single shadow, where do you go alone?
In evening rain you call, but the flock is lost
Alone above the cold pond, slow to descend
Low under islet clouds you pass unseen
The cold moon of the passes follows from afar
You may never meet the fowler's corded arrow
Yet flying alone is reason enough for dread
gist: A lost goose flies alone, and solitude is dread

title: 巴山道中除夜書懷
author: 崔塗
title_en: New Year's Eve on the Bashan Road: My Thoughts
english: Far and winding, the road through the Three Ba lands
A traveler in peril, ten thousand miles from home
A night of lingering snow on tangled mountains
One lone candle, and spring in a strange land
Ever farther from my own flesh and blood
I grow closer instead to my serving boy
How can I bear to drift about like this
When tomorrow the year turns new?
gist: One candle on New Year's Eve, far from all he loves

title: 宮詞其一
author: 張祜
english: My old home lies three thousand miles away
Twenty years shut deep within the palace
One strain of the song He Man Zi
And twin tears fall before my lord
gist: Twenty years locked away, one song brings her tears

title: 溪居
author: 柳宗元
english: Long was I burdened by the pins and cords of office
Glad now of this exile to the southern wilds
At leisure I neighbor farmers and their gardens
At times I seem a guest of hills and woods
At dawn I plow and turn the dew-wet grass
At night my oar rings on the stream's stones
Coming and going I meet no one
I sing long songs beneath the blue sky of Chu
gist: Exiled from office, he finds peace by the stream

title: 江雪
author: 柳宗元
english: Over a thousand hills no bird takes flight
On ten thousand paths all human tracks are gone
A lone boat, an old man in straw cloak and hat
Fishing alone in the cold river snow
gist: One old man fishing alone in a world of snow

title: 蜀先主廟
author: 劉禹錫
title_en: The Temple of the First Ruler of Shu
english: A hero's spirit fills heaven and earth
A thousand autumns on, it still commands awe
His power split the realm like a three-legged tripod
His cause restored the five-zhu coin
Gaining a minister, he could found a kingdom
The son he fathered did not match his worth
Desolate, the singing girls of fallen Shu
Came to dance before the palace of Wei
gist: A hero's awe endures, undone by an unworthy heir

title: 月夜
author: 杜甫
english: Tonight, beneath the moon over Fuzhou
She watches alone from her chamber
Far away, I pity our small children
Too young to understand this longing for Chang'an
Fragrant mist dampens her cloud-soft hair
Clear moonlight chills her jade-white arms
When shall we lean together by the thin curtain
Lit as one, the stains of our tears gone dry
gist: Apart, they watch one moon and dream of reunion

title: 春望
author: 杜甫
english: The state is broken; hills and rivers remain
Spring in the city; grass and trees grow deep
Moved by the times, the flowers draw my tears
Grieved at parting, birdsong startles my heart
Beacon fires have burned three months on end
A letter from home is worth ten thousand in gold
I scratch my white hair, ever thinner
Soon too sparse to hold a hairpin
gist: A ruined land in spring, flowers draw his tears

title: 春宿左省
author: 杜甫
title_en: Spring Night on Duty at the Chancellery
english: Flowers fade into dusk by the palace wall
Chirping birds fly past to their roosts
Stars hang trembling over ten thousand doors
Moonlight brims at the height of heaven
Sleepless, I listen for the golden key
In the wind I seem to hear jade bridle bells
At dawn I must present a sealed memorial
Again and again I ask how far the night has gone
gist: Sleepless on palace duty, he counts the night away

title: 月夜憶舍弟
author: 杜甫
title_en: Thinking of My Brothers on a Moonlit Night
english: Garrison drums cut off all travelers
On the autumn frontier one wild goose cries
From this night on, the dew turns white
The moon is brighter over my old home
I have brothers, all scattered now
No home where I might ask if they live or die
The letters I send never get through
And still the fighting has not ceased
gist: Brothers scattered by war, the home moon brightest

title: 天末憶李白
author: 杜甫
title_en: Thinking of Li Bai at the End of the Sky
english: A cool wind rises at the sky's far edge
My friend, how fares your heart?
When will the wild geese bring your word?
Rivers and lakes swell with autumn waters
Fine writing resents a life of easy fortune
Goblins delight when a man passes by
You must be sharing words with that wronged soul
Casting a poem as a gift into the Miluo
gist: Autumn wind carries worry to a poet friend in exile

title: 奉濟驛重送嚴公四韻
author: 杜甫
title_en: At Fengji Station, Seeing Off Lord Yan Once More: Four Couplets
english: Having seen you this far, here we must part
The green hills, in vain, still hold their feeling
When shall we hold our wine cups together again?
Last night we walked as one beneath the moon
Every district sings your praise and mourns your leaving
Through three reigns you served the court with honor
I go back alone to my river village
In solitude to nurse what life remains
gist: After parting, he returns alone to nurse his years

title: 別房太尉墓
author: 杜甫
title_en: Taking Leave at the Grave of Grand Marshal Fang
english: In a strange land, on official travels once more
I halt my horse to take leave of your lonely grave
Near my tears, no patch of earth stays dry
In the low sky hang broken clouds
At chess I kept you company, like Tutor Xie
Sword in hand, I seek the Lord of Xu
I see only the forest flowers falling
And hear orioles cry, seeing the traveler off
gist: Tears at a friend's lonely grave in a strange land

title: 旅夜書懷
author: 杜甫
title_en: Writing My Thoughts While Traveling at Night
english: Fine grass, a faint breeze along the bank
A tall mast, a lone boat in the night
Stars hang low over the wide level plains
The moon surges in the great river's flow
Is a name made by writings alone?
Old and ill, I have left office behind
Adrift and drifting, what am I like?
A single sand gull between heaven and earth
gist: Old and adrift, a lone gull between heaven and earth

title: 八陣圖
author: 杜甫
english: His deeds crowned a realm divided in three
His fame stands high on the Eight Formations
The river flows on, but the stones do not turn
His lasting regret: the failed conquest of Wu
gist: Fame endures, and so does regret for unconquered Wu

title: 登岳陽樓
author: 杜甫
english: Long ago I heard of Dongting's waters
Today at last I climb Yueyang Tower
Wu and Chu split apart to the southeast
Heaven and earth float here day and night
From kin and friends, not a single word
Old and sick, I have one lonely boat
War horses range north of the mountain passes
Leaning on the rail, I let my tears stream down
gist: Vast waters below, an old man weeps for the times

title: 望月懷遠
author: 張九齡
title_en: Gazing at the Moon and Longing for One Far Away
english: Over the sea the bright moon rises
At the sky's far edge we share this moment
The one who loves resents the endless night
And all night long is stirred by longing
I snuff the candle, cherishing the flood of light
I drape on my robe and feel the dew grow thick
I cannot fill my hands with light to send you
So back to sleep, to dream of our meeting
gist: Sharing the moon apart, he dreams of their meeting

title: 題大庾嶺北驛
author: 宋之問
title_en: Inscribed at the North Post Station of Dayu Ridge
english: In the tenth month the wild geese fly south
They say that here the geese turn back
My own journey is far from over
What day will I ever return?
The river is calm, the tide just ebbing
The woods grow dark, the miasma will not lift
Tomorrow at dawn, where I gaze toward home
I should see plum blossoms on the ridge
gist: The geese turn back here, but his exile goes on

title: 渡漢江
author: 宋之問
english: Beyond the ridges, all letters ceased
Through a winter, then through a spring
Nearing home, my heart grows more fearful
I dare not question those coming my way
gist: Nearing home at last, he fears to ask for news

title: 新年作
author: 宋之問
english: At the new year, longing for home cuts deep
At the sky's edge, alone, I shed tears
Old age has come, and I serve beneath others
Spring goes home before this traveler can
With ridge gibbons I share my dawns and dusks
With river willows, the wind and mist
Already I am like the tutor of Changsha
From now on, how many more years?
gist: Spring goes home before the aging exile can

title: 杜少府之任蜀州
author: 王勃
title_en: Farewell to Vice-Prefect Du Taking Office in Shuzhou
english: These walls and towers guarded by the land of Three Qin
Through wind and mist I gaze toward the Five Fords
With you I share the sorrow of this parting
For we are both travelers in official service
While a true friend remains within the four seas
The sky's far edge feels close as a next-door neighbor
So let us not, here where the road divides
Weep like children and soak our kerchiefs with tears
gist: True friends stay near though worlds apart, no tears

title: 和晉陵陸丞早春遊望
author: 杜審言
title_en: Matching Assistant Lu of Jinling's Poem on an Early Spring Outing
english: Only the traveler far from home on duty
Is startled so by the season's fresh signs
Clouds and rose mist bring dawn up from the sea
Plum and willow carry spring across the river
The mild air urges on the yellow orioles
Clear sunlight turns upon the green duckweed
Suddenly I hear a song in the ancient style
And longing for home nearly wets my kerchief
gist: Spring's fresh signs stir a traveler's homesickness

title: 登樓
author: 朱斌
english: The white sun sinks to rest along the hills
The Yellow River flows on into the sea
To stretch your gaze a thousand miles farther
Climb up one more story of the tower
gist: Climb one more story to see a thousand miles more

title: 望嶽
author: 杜甫
english: What shall I say of Mount Tai, lord of peaks?
Across Qi and Lu its green is never done
Creation gathered here its divine beauty
Its slopes divide the dusk from the dawn
Layered clouds rise up and cleanse my breast
My straining eyes follow the homing birds
One day I shall stand upon its very summit
And see at a glance how small all mountains are
gist: From Tai's summit all mountains will look small

title: 感遇其一
author: 張九齡
english: Orchid leaves grow lush and full in spring
Cassia blossoms shine bright and pure in autumn
Each so joyous and thriving with life
Makes of itself a season of beauty
Who would guess that dwellers in the woods
Catch their fragrance and sit in quiet delight?
Grass and trees have hearts of their own
Why should they ask a fair hand to pluck them?
gist: Flowers bloom for themselves, not to be plucked

title: 感遇其二
author: 張九齡
english: I return to the deep woods to lie alone
Washing stale cares away in lonely purity
I offer this in thanks to the high-flying bird
And ask it to carry my feelings to the distance
Day and night I nurse this empty longing
But who can sense a devotion so pure?
Those who soar and those who dive are sundered
What then is left to comfort my sincere heart?
gist: Pure devotion nursed in the woods, sensed by none

title: 尋陸鴻漸不遇
author: 皎然
title_en: Seeking Lu Hongjian and Not Finding Him
english: Though his new home lies close beside the city wall
A wild path leads in through mulberry and hemp
Chrysanthemums lately planted by the hedge
Have yet to flower though autumn has arrived
I knock at the gate; not even a dog barks
About to leave, I ask at the house to the west
They tell me he has gone into the mountains
And comes home each day only as the sun slants low
gist: The recluse is out in the hills till the sun slants

title: 谷口書齋寄楊補闕
author: 錢起
title_en: From My Study at Valley Mouth: To Rectifier Yang
english: Springs and ravines encircle my thatched cottage
Clouds and rose mist rise from the vine-draped screens
The bamboo is loveliest after a fresh rain
The hills are dearest at the hour of sunset
The idle egrets settle early to their roost
The autumn flowers fall later here than elsewhere
My houseboy sweeps the path beneath the vines
For yesterday I promised an old friend would come
gist: The path is swept, an old friend promised to come

title: 送僧歸日本
author: 錢起
title_en: Seeing Off a Monk Returning to Japan
english: You dwelt in this great land as karma led you
Your journey here was like a walk in dream
Afloat on heaven, the gray sea stretches far
Leaving the world, the Dharma boat rides light
Water and moon open the way of Chan insight
Fish and dragons listen to the chanted sutras
Dearest of all, the shadow of one lamp flame
Ten thousand miles shining before your eyes
gist: One lamp of Dharma lights his long voyage home

title: 和張僕射塞下曲
author: 錢起
title_en: Border Song, in Reply to Minister Zhang
english: The moon is dark, wild geese fly high
the Khan flees under cover of night
We would lead light horsemen in pursuit
but heavy snow covers our bows and blades
gist: The Khan flees by night, snow halts the pursuit

title: 酬程延秋夜即事見贈
author: 韓翃
title_en: In Reply to Cheng Yan's Poem on an Autumn Night
english: The long bamboo mat feels the wind early
pale moonlight lies on the empty city
One goose crosses the autumn River of Stars
washing mallets sound at night from a thousand homes
By every sign the season is growing late
the meeting we hoped for is still far off
All this while I have chanted your fine lines
not noticing the dawn crows already cry
gist: Chanting a friend's lines till crows cry at dawn

title: 寄全椒山中道士
author: 韋應物
title_en: To the Taoist Recluse in the Quanjiao Mountains
english: This morning my study in the prefecture is cold
and suddenly I think of my friend in the hills
Bundling brushwood at the bottom of the ravine
he comes home to boil white stones
I would carry him a gourd of wine
to comfort him far off this night of wind and rain
But fallen leaves fill the empty mountain
where could I ever find his tracks
gist: Longing to bring wine, but leaves hide his path

title: 秋夜寄丘二十二員外
author: 韋應物
title_en: An Autumn Night, Sent to Official Qiu
english: Thinking of you on this autumn night
I stroll and sing to the cool sky
In the empty hills a pine cone falls
the recluse too must still be awake
gist: A pine cone falls in empty hills, you too lie awake

title: 賦得暮雨送李胄
author: 韋應物
title_en: Evening Rain: Seeing Off Li Zhou
english: Fine rain falls on the river of Chu
evening bells are sounding in Jianye
Through the haze the sails come in heavy
in the gloom the birds fly slowly off
The sea gate lies too deep to see
trees on the far shore hold the wet
Boundless is my feeling as we part
tears soak my lapel like scattering threads of rain
gist: Parting in river rain, tears fall like its threads

title: 長安遇馮著
author: 韋應物
english: A traveler comes from the east
the rain of Baling still on his clothes
I ask the traveler why he has come
to buy an axe to cut wood in the hills
Unseen in the mist the flowers are opening
fluttering swallows feed their new brood
We parted just yesterday, now it is spring
how many gray threads have grown at our temples
gist: Spring returns with a friend, and new gray hairs

title: 夕次盱眙縣
author: 韋應物
title_en: Mooring at Evening in Xuyi County
english: Lowering sail, I stop at a town on the Huai
mooring the boat beside a lonely post station
A vast wind sets the waves rising
in gathering dark the sun sinks into dusk
People go home as the hill town grows dim
geese settle on the white reed shoals
Alone in the night I recall the passes of Qin
a sleepless traveler listening to the bell
gist: Moored at dusk, a sleepless traveler hears the bell

title: 和晉陵陸丞早春遊望
author: 韋應物
title_en: An Early Spring View, in Reply to Assistant Lu of Jinling
english: Only the official wandering far from home
is startled that the season is made new
Clouds and rosy dawn rise out of the sea
plum and willow carry spring across the river
Mild airs urge on the yellow orioles
clear light shines on the green duckweed
Suddenly I hear your song in its bitter key
and longing for home nearly wets my kerchief
gist: New spring far from home stirs tears of longing

title: 寄左省杜拾遺
author: 岑參
title_en: Sent to Reminder Du of the Left Office
english: Side by side we hasten up the crimson steps
posted apart on either side of the palace hall
At dawn we enter behind the imperial guard
at dusk we return steeped in the court's incense
White-haired, I grieve to see the blossoms fall
and envy the birds that soar into the blue
In this sage reign nothing is left amiss
so I find my letters of counsel growing few
gist: Gray at court, he envies birds and writes little

title: 訪羊尊師
author: 孫革
english: Beneath the pines I asked the serving boy
He said the master had gone to gather herbs
He is somewhere on this very mountain
But the clouds are too deep to tell where
gist: Gone gathering herbs, lost somewhere in deep clouds

title: 書邊事
author: 張喬
english: A bugle call breaks off in the clear autumn
A soldier leans upon the garrison tower
Spring wind blows across the Green Tomb
The white sun sets over Liangzhou
The great Han realm has no troops to bar the way
On the far frontier travelers still roam
The border tribes' hearts are like this river
Forever longing to flow toward the south
gist: Peace on the frontier, hearts flowing to the south

title: 玉階怨
author: 李白
english: On the jade steps white dew is forming
Deep into night it soaks her silken stockings
She lowers at last the crystal curtain
And through its glitter watches the autumn moon
gist: Dew soaked and waiting, she watches the autumn moon

title: 靜夜思
author: 李白
english: Before my bed I watch the moonlight
I take it for frost upon the ground
I raise my head to gaze at the mountain moon
I bow my head and think of my old home
gist: Moonlight like frost stirs longing for home

title: 贈孟浩然
author: 李白
english: How I love Master Meng
His free spirit known to all the world
In rosy youth he spurned the carriage and the cap
White-haired now he lies among pines and clouds
Drunk on moonlight, often deep in sagely wine
Lost among flowers, he serves no lord
How can one look up to a mountain so high
I can only bow here to his pure fragrance
gist: He bows to Meng's free spirit, high as a mountain

title: 渡荊門送別
author: 李白
english: I sail far out beyond the Jingmen hills
Coming to wander the old land of Chu
The mountains end where level plains begin
The river pours into the boundless wilds
Beneath the moon a mirror flies from heaven
Clouds rise and build their towers of mirage
Still the waters of my homeland follow me
Ten thousand miles they speed my traveling boat
gist: Homeland waters follow his boat ten thousand miles

title: 送友人
author: 李白
english: Green hills stretch across the northern wall
White water winds about the eastern town
Here in this place we make our last farewell
A lone tumbleweed bound ten thousand miles
Drifting clouds are the wanderer's thoughts
The setting sun an old friend's parting heart
We wave our hands and go our separate ways
Our parting horses neigh and neigh again
gist: Clouds drift, sun sets, parting horses neigh again

title: 夜泊牛渚懷古
author: 李白
title_en: Mooring at Night by Niuzhu, Recalling the Past
english: Night at Niuzhu on the western river
The blue sky holds not a single shred of cloud
I board my boat to gaze at the autumn moon
And vainly call to mind General Xie
I too can chant my verses loud and high
But such a man is nowhere to be heard
Tomorrow morning I will hoist my sail
While maple leaves fall drifting all around
gist: He sings to the moon, but no one like Xie listens

title: 聽蜀僧濬彈琴
author: 李白
title_en: Listening to Jun, a Monk of Shu, Play the Qin
english: The monk of Shu cradles his green-silk qin
Descending westward from Mount Emei's peak
For me he sweeps one hand across the strings
And I hear pines in ten thousand valleys
Flowing waters cleanse this traveler's heart
The lingering notes merge with the frosted bell
Unnoticed, dusk falls on the emerald hills
And autumn clouds grow dark, fold upon fold
gist: Qin music like pines, dusk falls unnoticed

title: 怨情
author: 李白
english: The lovely woman rolls up the beaded curtain
Sitting long, she knits her moth-fine brows
One sees only the wet traces of tears
No one knows whom her heart resents
gist: Tears betray her, but no one knows whom she resents

title: 淮上喜會梁川故人
author: 韋應物
title_en: Glad Meeting on the Huai with an Old Friend from Liangchuan
english: On the Jiang and Han we both once sojourned
Each time we met, we went home drunk
Since we parted like drifting clouds
Ten years have run by like flowing water
Our laughter and warmth are just as of old
Yet our thinning temples are streaked with gray
What keeps me from going back north?
On the Huai I face the autumn hills
gist: Ten years gone like water, laughter still the same

title: 初發揚子寄元大校書
author: 韋應物
title_en: Setting Out from Yangzi: Sent to Collator Yuan
english: Grieving, I leave those dear to me
Adrift, I enter the mist and haze
My oars turn homeward, a Luoyang man
A fading bell sounds in Guangling's trees
This morning, here, we say farewell
Where shall we ever meet again?
The world's affairs: a boat upon the waves
Swept on and back, how can it hold still?
gist: Parting in the mist, life a boat upon the waves

title: 江南曲
author: 李益
english: I married a merchant of Qutang
Day after day he fails his word to me
Had I known the tide keeps faith
I would have wed a rider of the tides
gist: The tide keeps faith better than her husband

title: 玉階怨
author: 李白
english: White dew forms upon the jade steps
Deep in the night it soaks her silken stockings
She lets the crystal curtain fall
And through its glitter watches the autumn moon
gist: Behind the lowered curtain she still eyes the moon

title: 長干曲其一
author: 崔顥
english: Sir, where exactly is your home?
I myself live at Hengtang
I stay my boat to ask a moment
Perhaps we come from the same town
gist: She stays her boat, hoping he is from her town

title: 長干曲其二
author: 崔顥
english: My home stands by the Nine Rivers' waters
I come and go along the Nine Rivers' side
We are both people of Changgan
Yet from childhood we never met
gist: Both of Changgan, yet strangers since childhood

title: 登鸛雀樓
author: 王之渙
english: The white sun sinks away along the hills
The Yellow River flows into the sea
To stretch your gaze a thousand miles
Climb one more story of the tower
gist: Climb one more story to see a thousand miles

title: 送李端
author: 嚴維
english: Withered grass spreads over the old pass
This parting is truly hard to bear
Your road leads out beyond the cold clouds
You go home as the evening snow comes down
Orphaned young, I wandered early
Through many troubles, I knew you late
Hiding my tears, I gaze after you in vain
In wind and dust, when can we meet again?
gist: Snow falls on a parting, a friend known too late
